text:
maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in embeddings latency starting ~10:12 PT. Ops is looking; some similarity-search requests are slower. Marketing: please hold the webinar promo email for now.

incident-bot: [alert] embeddings_latency_up detected at 10:12 PT.

kevin: Copy that. Pausing sends. Can ops give a short, customer-friendly blurb we can put on statuspage + a suggested cadence for updates?

chris: Root cause looks like GC pressure on cache nodes causing KV stall. Rolling restart of affected nodes started 10:20 PT. Mitigation ETA 15-25m for full recovery. No data loss.

olivia: For comms cadence: initial "Investigating" now, follow-up update in ~30m, then "Monitoring/Resolved" after 15m of stable traffic. Avoid promising a precise fix time until validated.

maya: Draft statuspage/email blurb for review:```We're investigating increased latency for embedding and similarity search requests affecting a subset of traffic. Our engineers are actively mitigating the issue; some requests may take longer than usual. No data loss is expected. We'll post updates here and via email.``` Thoughts?

kevin: Nice start. Tighten language: change "requests" -> "similarity/embedding requests" and add an explicit next-update ETA (30 minutes). Don't add enterprise contact link on the public status page.

maya: Updated copy below:```Status: Investigating
Summary: We're investigating increased latency impacting some similarity and embeddings requests. Engineers are mitigating (rolling restarts). No data loss is expected.
Next update: ~30 minutes (or earlier if we have news).
Impact: Elevated latency for a subset of inference requests; some retries may be needed.``` Also proposing we postpone today's webinar promo email by 24 hours to avoid noisy inbox timing. If ops clears in <30m, we can keep the original send but hold for now.

chris: Restart completed 10:31 PT. Initial telemetry looks good; p95 latency returning to baseline. Running a 15m smoke window to confirm.

olivia: Recommend waiting for the 15m stability window before marking resolved and before re-scheduling any promotional sends. If stable we can re-open the webinar send queue in +1h.

kevin: OK — I'll queue the hold and message Sales/Customer Success: short proactive note to affected enterprise customers offering a 1:1 if they saw impact. Draft for review:```Hi — we observed elevated latency affecting embeddings earlier today. Our engineers mitigated the issue and we're continuing to monitor; if you experienced any impact we'd like to offer a quick check-in. Reply and we'll set up a 1:1.```

maya: Published initial statuspage entry at 10:13 PT with the "Investigating" copy. Updated to "Monitoring" at 10:32 PT after Chris's restart and the initial smoke pass.

kevin: Will hold the webinar promo send and notify the comms queue. If we stay stable for the next 15m, I'll schedule the send for +1h.

chris: Monitoring is green at 10:40 PT. No regression in the last 10m of traffic. Keep monitoring; rollback plan stood by but not used.

olivia: Agreed — keep the public status at "Monitoring" for another 15m, then switch to "Resolved" with a brief post-incident note about root cause (GC on cache nodes) and mitigation (rolling restarts).

maya: Final resolution draft for statuspage/email:```Status: Resolved
Summary: We resolved elevated latency for similarity and embeddings requests caused by GC pressure on cache nodes. Engineers performed rolling restarts; service is back to normal. No customer data was lost.
Timeline: Issue began ~10:12 PT, mitigated 10:31 PT, fully validated by 10:55 PT.
Follow-up: We're implementing changes to reduce GC impact and will share a short postmortem with any customers who request it.``` Approving this?

kevin: Approved. I'll publish resolution at 10:56 PT after the 15m green window and then re-open the webinar send queue for +1h if stable. Also sending the enterprise touch note now.

maya: Thanks everyone. Quick TODOs: kevin — enterprise touch + pause promo, chris/eng — postmortem notes (brief) for marketing, olivia — approve final timing for webinar re-open. We'll keep this thread for any last-minute copy changes.

kevin: Done (paused and enterprise note sent).

chris: Postmortem draft in #postmortems in 2h.

olivia: Webinar re-open approved if stable.

maya: Closing loop — resolution posted at 10:56 PT. Will post final link to the statuspage and the enterprise note in this thread. :white_check_mark:
